name: Reveal
summary: Opens and closes content in place (Q65 P4, strategy S3): the box grows from nothing to the content's height (grid rows `0fr` ↔ `1fr`, one mechanism in every engine, MD7) while the content fades in; closing fades it out quickly and collapses. Only what follows moves, inside the layout budget (R3). Interrupted, it reverses from where it is. Not for something that appears from nowhere over the page (a popover, a toast: their own enter and exit), or for content replaced in the same box (Morph).
a11y: Closed content is `inert` and hidden, so it is never focused, read or found; the owner keeps the disclosure's own `aria-expanded` and labelling. Focus rings inside are clipped only while it moves; once open, nothing is clipped. Reduced motion: no growing (it snaps), the content still fades.

props.name: open
props.description: Shown or hidden. A change reveals or collapses the content in place; mounting already open reveals it once.

props.name: appear
props.description: Reveal once when it mounts already open (a field message that just arrived). Off by default: first paint never animates (Z19).

props.name: children
props.description: The content that opens and closes: a disclosure's panel, a tree branch, a field's message.
